lyrics.ja: がんばることに夢中で
lyrics.romaji: Ganbaru Koto ni Muchuu de
lyrics.en: So lost in the rush to give it all
lyrics.zh: 埋首拚命向前

notes.meaning: to be dedicated in sth 忘我地沈醉

lyrics.ja: 後ろを見る余裕もなかったよね
lyrics.romaji: Ushiro wo Miru Yoyuu mo Nakatta yo ne
lyrics.en: and you left no room to spare a glance behind, did you?
lyrics.zh: 連回首的餘暇也沒有留給自己呢

lyrics.ja: ふと深く息吸って周りを見渡したなら
lyrics.romaji: Futo Fukaku Iki Sutte Mawari wo Miwatashita Nara
lyrics.en: If you take a deep breath and look around
lyrics.zh: 若你深深吸一口氣，環顧四周，

notes.meaning: out of the blue 不經意地

lyrics.ja: きっと見つかるよ
lyrics.romaji: Kitto Mitsukaru yo
lyrics.en: You'll surely find it -
lyrics.zh: 你定能找到的

lyrics.ja: キミの居場所が
lyrics.romaji: Kimi no Ibasho ga
lyrics.en: the place to belong
lyrics.zh: 那屬於你的歸宿

notes.meaning: the place one belong 容身之所

lyrics.ja: いつだってキミを支えていきたい
lyrics.romaji: Itsu Datte Kimi wo Sasaete Ikitai
lyrics.en: I always want to keep supporting you
lyrics.zh: 無論何時都想一直支持你

lyrics.ja: 怖がらないでね　こっちを向いてよ
lyrics.romaji: Kowagaranaide ne Kocchi wo Muite yo
lyrics.en: Don't be afraid — look at me
lyrics.zh: 別害怕，望向我吧

lyrics.ja: 小さな一歩　踏み出したときから
lyrics.romaji: Chiisana Ippo Fumidashita Toki kara
lyrics.en: From the moment you take a small step forward
lyrics.zh: 從邁出那小小一步的一刻起

lyrics.ja: 未来は変わってくはずだよ
lyrics.romaji: Mirai ha Kawatteku Hazu Da yo
lyrics.en: The future would begin to change
lyrics.zh: 未來一定會隨之改變的

notes.meaning: should, be supposed to 應該

lyrics.ja: どんなときでも傍にいるから
lyrics.romaji: Donna Toki demo Soba ni Iru kara
lyrics.en: I will be by your side whenever it is
lyrics.zh: 無論何時我都會在你身旁

lyrics.ja: これから先もずっと一緒だよ
lyrics.romaji: Kore kara Saki mo Zutto Issho Da yo
lyrics.en: From now on, we'll always be together
lyrics.zh: 從今以後也永遠在一起喔

lyrics.ja: いつでも見守っているからね
lyrics.romaji: Itsu demo Mimamotte Iru kara ne
lyrics.en: I'll always be watching over you, okay?
lyrics.zh: 我會一直守護著你喔

lyrics.ja: 諦めないで空に向かって手を伸ばしたら
lyrics.romaji: Akiramenaide Sora ni Mukatte Te wo Nobashitara
lyrics.en: If you don't give up and reach your hand towards the sky
lyrics.zh: 只要別放棄，向天空伸出手

lyrics.ja: たしかに見えるよ
lyrics.romaji: Tashika ni Mieru yo
lyrics.en: You can definitely see it
lyrics.zh: 便能清晰看見

lyrics.ja: 輝く星が
lyrics.romaji: Kagayaku Hoshi ga
lyrics.en: The shining stars
lyrics.zh: 那熠熠生輝的星光

lyrics.ja: 夜空を見上げ一人
lyrics.romaji: Yozora wo Miage Hitori
lyrics.en: Looking up at the night sky, alone
lyrics.zh: 獨自一人仰望着夜空

lyrics.ja: 泣きだしそうな私を包み込んでくれたのは
lyrics.romaji: Nakidashisou na Watashi wo Tsutsumikonde Kureta no ha
lyrics.en: As I was about to cry,
lyrics.zh: 快要落淚 - 是你那句不經意的

lyrics.ja: 「大丈夫だよ」
lyrics.romaji: 「Daijoubu Da yo」
lyrics.en: it was your "It's okay", that softly held me tight
lyrics.zh: 「沒事的」將我溫柔包裹

lyrics.ja: その何気ないキミの一言
lyrics.romaji: Sono Nanigenai Kimi no Hitokoto
lyrics.en: That casual word from you
lyrics.zh: 你那不經意的一句話

lyrics.ja: 不思議と力が溢れてくるの
lyrics.romaji: Fushigi to Chikara ga Afurete Kuru no
lyrics.en: Mysteriously fills me with the strength to move forward
lyrics.zh: 不可思議地，力氣就這樣湧了上來

lyrics.ja: 「とまりたくない」
lyrics.romaji: 「Tomaritakunai」
lyrics.en: "I don't want to stop"
lyrics.zh: 「我不想停下」

lyrics.ja: 自分に嘘はつけないから
lyrics.romaji: Jibun ni Uso ha Tsukenai kara
lyrics.en: Because I can't lie to myself
lyrics.zh: 因為無法對自己說謊

lyrics.ja: わたし、いまもここに立ってるの
lyrics.romaji: Watashi, Ima mo Koko ni Tatteru no
lyrics.en: I'm still standing here now
lyrics.zh: 我如今仍然站在這裡

lyrics.ja: 光り輝く　青色の海
lyrics.romaji: Hikari Kagayaku Aoiro no Umi
lyrics.en: A shining, blue sea
lyrics.zh: 閃耀光芒的藍色海洋

lyrics.ja: 忘れられない思い出をまた
lyrics.romaji: Wasurerarenai Omoide wo Mata
lyrics.en: Again and again, I want to keep building
lyrics.zh: 難以忘懷的回憶，

lyrics.ja: キミと一緒に作っていきたいの
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to Issho ni Tsukutte Ikitai no
lyrics.en: unforgettable memories with you
lyrics.zh: 想再一次和你一起創造下去

lyrics.ja: あのステージの奥に見える夢の先まで
lyrics.romaji: Ano Suteeji no Oku ni Mieru Yume no Saki made
lyrics.en: All the way beyond the stage where the dream stretches on -
lyrics.zh: 直到那舞台的盡頭，夢想的彼端

lyrics.ja: 必ず　連れてくと
lyrics.romaji: Kanarazu Tsureteku to
lyrics.en: I'll take you there
lyrics.zh: 我一定會帶你到那裏的

lyrics.ja: 約束するよ
lyrics.romaji: Yakusoku Suru yo
lyrics.en: I promise
lyrics.zh: 我向你保證

lyrics.ja: 辛い時でも　苦しい時も
lyrics.romaji: Tsurai Toki demo Kurushii Toki mo
lyrics.en: No matter aching days, or in painful nights
lyrics.zh: 無論艱辛也好，還是痛苦也好

lyrics.ja: みんなで手を繋いで進もう
lyrics.romaji: Minna de Te wo Tsunaide Susumou
lyrics.en: Let's hold hands and move forward together
lyrics.zh: 大家牽着手一起前進吧

lyrics.ja: 曇っていた心晴れるよ
lyrics.romaji: Kumotte Ita Kokoro Hareru yo
lyrics.en: The cloudy heart will clear up
lyrics.zh: 汚雲密佈的心也會放晴

lyrics.ja: 一人一人の言の葉が虹のように空へ
lyrics.romaji: Hitori Hitori no Kotonoha ga Niji no You ni Sora e
lyrics.en: Each and every word we speak, spreads across the sky like a rainbow
lyrics.zh: 你和我的一字一句如彩虹般鋪向天際

lyrics.ja: 広がり　創るよ　七色の世界
lyrics.romaji: Hirogari Tsukuru yo Nanairo no Sekai
lyrics.en: and together, we will create a world of seven hues
lyrics.zh: 綻放開來，創造出這七彩的世界

lyrics.ja: ここから新しいときが始まるよ
lyrics.romaji: Koko kara Atarashii Toki ga Hajimaru yo
lyrics.en: From here, a new chapter begins
lyrics.zh: 全新的時空，將從這裡開始
